scripts.build: node tools/prepare-native-artifacts.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node tools/prepare-native-artifacts.ts --bundle
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.unit.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.integration.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.components.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.registry.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.package.json --noEmit
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run build && node tools/run-unit-tests.mjs --suite integration
scripts.test:registry: pnpm run build && node tools/run-unit-tests.mjs --suite registry
scripts.fixture:check: pnpm run fixture:tokens:check && pnpm --dir tests/fixtures/consumer run check
scripts.fixture:build: pnpm run fixture:tokens:check && pnpm --dir tests/fixtures/consumer run build
scripts.test:fixture: pnpm run fixture:build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/smoke/consumer-fixture.test.mjs tests/smoke/owned-server.test.mjs tests/smoke/lifecycle-consumer.test.mjs tests/smoke/q2-resulting-consumer.test.mjs
scripts.test:browser: pnpm run fixture:build && playwright test --config playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:package: pnpm run build && node tools/run-unit-tests.mjs --suite package
scripts.native:runtime:check: tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --types node --allowImportingTsExtensions --target ES2023 --module NodeNext --strict tools/build-svelte-runtime.ts tools/build-svelte-runtime.test.ts tools/native-runtime/archive.ts tools/native-runtime/recipe.ts tools/native-artifacts.ts tools/prepare-native-artifacts.ts tools/prepare-native-artifacts.test.ts && node --test tools/build-svelte-runtime.test.ts
